headline: Stema Landing Wakes Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
war_summary: Stema Landing opens this dispatch: four base events in the past two hours, the newest logged some twenty minutes before filing, with The Wane the busiest post and all nine of its works still in Colonial hands. Fishermen's Row, our last edition's lead, remains the day's busiest ground, twenty-three events on the day's ledger and three more in the latest span; its nine works now stand eight Warden to one Colonial, a further turn from the seven-two split last reported, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post again drawing the fire. Godcrofts has cooled to a single recent event, and its lone no-man's-land post has been restored, putting all nine works in Warden hands. The Deadlands have filed no base events for more than five hours, yet combined losses near four thousand in the past two hours and still climb; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot remain the contested posts, and eight of eleven works are Colonial-held. Tempest Island keeps one work in no-man's-land, while Linn of Mercy and Farranac Coast, quiet on bases, show steeply rising losses. The Weathered Expanse, likewise silent, counts better than fourteen thousand casualties a side over the day. This is the eightieth day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
